name: Saw this and thought of you
title: Saw this and thought of you
note: Rendered words at bottom because her hair reached the top quarter; no redraws
caption:
Saw this and thought of you. Send it to the one who came to mind.

Fear can feel loud some days, but it is not what God gives. He gives power, love, and a steady mind, and that is worth reminding someone of today.

2 Timothy 1:7 (BSB)

Keep this one close.
